04 / Common questions

Before you visit.

Can I ask about both braces and clear aligners?

Yes. Share your preferences during the consultation so your orthodontist can explain which approaches may suit your teeth and bite.

What should I bring to my first visit?

Bring any dental records you already have and a list of questions, concerns or goals you’d like to discuss.

When will I know how long treatment could take?

Ask for an estimate after your assessment. Your orthodontist can explain what may affect the timeline for your case.
